q: 分布式缓存题的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: set/get/delete key-value
为 key 配置过期时间 TTL
按 LRU 策略淘汰数据
支持复杂 SQL 查询和事务
options_en: Set, get, and delete key-value pairs.
Configure a TTL (expiration time) for each key.
Evict data using an LRU policy.
Support complex SQL queries and transactions.
why: 核心功能是 key-value 的增删查、TTL 过期和 LRU 淘汰；复杂查询、事务留给数据库，不是缓存的职责。
why_en: The core requirements are key-value set/get/delete, TTL expiration, and LRU eviction — not SQL queries or transactions.
optionExplanations: 对：这是缓存最基本的读写接口。
对：TTL 让条目按时间自动失效。
对：LRU 决定容量满时删哪条。
错：SQL 与事务是数据库职责，缓存不做。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: basic read/write is the minimum a cache must expose.
Correct: TTL lets entries expire automatically.
Correct: LRU decides what to evict when full.
Incorrect: complex SQL and transactions belong to a database, not a cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的过期时间，过期后必须重新获取或重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the expiration time after which a cached entry must be refreshed or rebuilt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用淘汰策略，容量满时优先删最久没访问的条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU evicts the entry that has gone the longest without being accessed.

q: 本题的核心非功能需求有哪些？（多选）
options: 高可用，接受 eventual consistency
get/set 延迟低于约 10ms
支撑约 1TB 数据和 100k RPS
每次重启后必须恢复全部缓存数据
options_en: High availability, with eventual consistency accepted.
Get/set latency under about 10ms.
Scale to roughly 1TB of data and 100k requests per second.
All cached data must survive every restart.
why: 非功能需求是高可用、低延迟（<10ms）和规模（1TB/100k RPS）；跨重启持久化被明确排除在外。
why_en: The non-functional requirements are high availability, sub-10ms latency, and scale to about 1TB and 100k RPS — durability across restarts is out of scope.
optionExplanations: 对：缓存优先可用，弱一致换取始终能响应。
对：这是缓存存在的意义，要比数据库快一个数量级。
对：这是文章给的规模上限，后面容量估算都基于它。
错：durability 明确 below the line，重启丢失可接受。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: the cache favors availability over strict consistency.
Correct: sub-10ms latency is the whole point of using a cache.
Correct: this is the stated scale target the later capacity math is based on.
Incorrect: durability across restarts is explicitly out of scope.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本可能短暂不同步，但最终会收敛到相同值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means replicas may briefly disagree but converge to the same value over time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒请求数，用来衡量系统吞吐量。

scenario: 面试官给出规模假设：最多要存约 1TB 数据，峰值约 100k 请求每秒。
q: 这两个数量级最直接支持哪条设计判断？
options: 只要选对索引，单机 Postgres 就能扛住
这规模下不需要考虑复制或分片
单机内存和单机吞吐都不够，必须水平扩展到多节点
TTL 和 LRU 可以砍掉，专注加机器就够
options_en: With the right index, a single Postgres instance can handle it.
At this scale, replication or sharding is unnecessary.
Single-node memory and throughput are both insufficient — the cache must scale out across nodes.
TTL and LRU can be cut; just add more machines.
why: 1TB 超过单机可用内存，100k RPS 超过单机吞吐上限，两者都指向要把缓存拆成多节点集群。
why_en: Both the 1TB storage target and the 100k RPS throughput target exceed what one machine can hold, so the cache must scale out across many nodes.

q: 补全缓存题的核心实体：
text: 分布式缓存最核心的实体就是 {{Key}} 和 {{Value}}，以及每个 entry 可能携带的 expiry timestamp 与 LRU node 指针。
why: 这题的领域模型很薄，难点不在实体丰富度，而在 TTL、LRU 和分布式扩展。面试里不要在实体阶段花太久。
why_en: The cache's core entities are simply keys and values, with metadata such as expiry timestamps and LRU pointers added for behavior.

q: 基础 API 应该暴露哪些操作？（多选）
options: POST /:key 设置 value
GET /:key 读取 value
DELETE /:key 删除 key
JOIN /:key 做多表关联
options_en: POST /:key to set a value.
GET /:key to read a value.
DELETE /:key to remove a key.
JOIN /:key to perform a multi-table join.
why: API 直接映射 set/get/delete 三个操作；TTL 可作为 set 的参数，复杂关联查询不属于缓存接口。
why_en: The API maps directly to set, get, and delete; TTL rides along as a parameter on set, and joins are not a cache responsibility.
optionExplanations: 对：写入接口，可带 TTL 参数。
对：读取接口，未命中通常返回空。
对：删除接口，主动失效一个 key。
错：JOIN 是关系数据库能力，key-value 缓存没有多表概念。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: the write endpoint, optionally carrying a TTL.
Correct: the read endpoint, typically empty on a miss.
Correct: the delete endpoint actively invalidates a key.
Incorrect: joins are a relational-database feature; a key-value cache has no multi-table concept.

scenario: 先做一个单机 MVP，只需要支持 key-value 的 set/get/delete，并追求 O(1) 读写。
q: 最直接的数据结构是什么？
options: 哈希表 / map
B+ 树
倒排索引
优先队列
options_en: A hash table / map.
A B+ tree.
An inverted index.
A priority queue.
tradeoff: O(1) key 查找 vs 范围扫描/排序能力
why: 哈希表提供按 key 的 O(1) 平均查找、插入、删除，正好匹配单机 MVP 的需求。
why_en: A hash table gives O(1) average lookup, insert, and delete for exactly the key-based access this MVP needs.
whenOtherWins: 需要范围扫描或排序时 B+ 树更合适；需要全文检索时才轮到倒排索引。
optionExplanations: 对：按 key 存取，O(1) 平均复杂度。
错：B+ 树强在范围查询，这里没有范围需求。
错：倒排索引是搜索引擎结构，不解决 key-value 存取。
错：优先队列按优先级排序，不是通用查找结构。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: key-based access with O(1) average complexity.
Incorrect: B+ trees excel at range queries, which this MVP doesn't need.
Incorrect: inverted indexes power search engines, not key-value lookup.
Incorrect: a priority queue orders by priority, not a general lookup structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希函数把 key 映射到存储位置的数据结构，平均 O(1) 存取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to storage slots via a hash function, giving average O(1) access.

scenario: 缓存 entry 可以设置 TTL；访问时如果已过期，不能返回旧值，还应释放内存。
q: get(key) 里最关键的逻辑是什么？
options: 检查 expiry，过期则从 data 中删除该 key 并返回 null
不检查 expiry，无论是否过期都直接返回 value
只更新 LRU 顺序，完全不检查过期时间
每次 get 都对所有 key 做一次全量扫描后再返回
options_en: Check expiry; if expired, delete the key from data and return null.
Skip the expiry check and always return the value.
Only update LRU order, without checking expiry at all.
Do a full scan of every key on every get before returning.
codeSample:
get(key):
  (value, expiry) = data[key]
  if expiry and currentTime() > expiry:
    delete data[key]
    return null
  return value
tradeoff: 读时惰性校验新鲜度 vs 直接返回缓存值
why: get 必须先查 expiry，过期就删除并返回 null，否则调用方会读到 stale 数据。
why_en: The get path must check expiry first and return null on expiry, or callers will read stale data.
whenOtherWins: 若业务能接受短暂 stale read，可以只靠后台清理，不在读路径强制检查。
optionExplanations: 对：过期即删并回收内存，读到的永远是新鲜值。
错：会把已经过期的数据当有效值返回。
错：只动 LRU 顺序，没检查是否已经过期。
错：全表扫描是 O(n)，get 应该保持 O(1)。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: deleting on expiry keeps every read fresh and reclaims memory.
Incorrect: this would return already-expired data as if it were still valid.
Incorrect: touching only the LRU order skips the expiry check entirely.
Incorrect: a full scan is O(n); get should stay O(1).

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的过期时间，过期后必须重新获取或重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the expiration time after which a cached entry must be refreshed or rebuilt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存里的值已经过期或与真实值不符。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stale data is a cached value that is expired or no longer matches the source of truth.

q: 只在 get 时清理过期 key 的后果是什么？
options: 未被访问的过期 key 会继续占内存
所有过期 key 会立刻消失
LRU 不再需要
set 延迟必然超过 10ms
options_en: Unaccessed expired keys keep occupying memory.
All expired keys disappear immediately.
LRU is no longer needed.
Set latency must exceed 10ms.
why: 懒删除只在被访问时才清理，冷 key 过期后没人读就会一直占用内存，需要后台 janitor 补上。
why_en: Lazy expiry only cleans up on access, so cold expired keys sit in memory until a background janitor removes them.
optionExplanations: 对：没人读的过期 key 会一直留在内存里。
错：懒删除恰恰不会立刻清理，只有被访问才触发。
错：LRU 淘汰和 TTL 过期是两套独立机制，互不替代。
错：这里讨论的是内存占用，不是 set 延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: keys nobody reads keep sitting in memory.
Incorrect: lazy expiry does the opposite — cleanup only fires on access.
Incorrect: LRU eviction and TTL expiry are independent mechanisms.
Incorrect: this is about memory occupancy, not set latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只有访问到某个 key 时才检查并清理过期数据的方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lazy deletion only checks and removes an expired key when it is actually accessed.

q: TTL 后台 janitor 的核心取舍是什么？
options: CPU 扫描成本 vs 内存回收及时性
强一致 vs 事务隔离
图片质量 vs 压缩率
DNS 缓存 vs TLS 握手
options_en: CPU scan cost vs. how promptly memory is reclaimed.
Strong consistency vs. transaction isolation.
Image quality vs. compression ratio.
DNS caching vs. TLS handshake.
tradeoff: 扫描频率高低 vs CPU 开销
why: 扫描越频繁，内存回收越及时，但更耗 CPU；间隔应结合内存压力和延迟目标调节。
why_en: Scanning more often reclaims memory sooner but burns more CPU, so the interval should track memory pressure and latency goals.
optionExplanations: 对：这正是 janitor 扫描间隔要平衡的两端。
错：这是数据库事务话题，与 TTL 清理无关。
错：这是多媒体压缩话题，跑题了。
错：这是网络协议话题，跑题了。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: this is exactly the axis the janitor's scan interval balances.
Incorrect: that's a database-transaction topic, unrelated to TTL cleanup.
Incorrect: that's a media-compression topic, off track.
Incorrect: that's a networking-protocol topic, off track.

termDefinitions.meaning: 周期性后台清理进程，用来主动删除过期数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A janitor is a periodic background process that proactively removes expired data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 传输层加密协议，用于建立安全连接，握手有额外开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TLS is a transport-layer encryption protocol; its handshake adds connection-setup overhead.

scenario: 需要按精确 LRU 淘汰，同时 get/set 都要保持 O(1)，不能每次淘汰时全表扫描。
q: 应该组合哪两种数据结构？
options: 哈希表 + 双向链表
数组 + 冒泡排序
B 树 + 倒排索引
队列 + 布隆过滤器
options_en: A hash table plus a doubly linked list.
An array plus bubble sort.
A B-tree plus an inverted index.
A queue plus a Bloom filter.
tradeoff: O(1) 定位与移动 vs 排序/近似结构的额外开销
why: 哈希表 O(1) 定位 node，双向链表 O(1) 移动和删除；头部最近使用，尾部最久未用。
why_en: A hash table locates a node in O(1) and a doubly linked list moves or removes it in O(1), with recency ordered from head to tail.
whenOtherWins: 只需要近似 LRU 时，采样等方式更省内存；要做 LFU 则需要频率结构，不是纯 recency list。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Key[Key] --> Map[Hash map]
Map --> Node[List node]
Head[MRU head] <--> Node
Node <--> Tail[LRU tail]
optionExplanations: 对：查找和移动都是 O(1)，天然支持 LRU 语义。
错：冒泡排序是 O(n²)，远达不到 O(1) 淘汰。
错：B 树和倒排索引解决查询/检索，不是 recency 排序。
错：布隆过滤器只能判断“可能存在”，不能记录访问顺序。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: both lookup and reordering are O(1), a natural fit for LRU.
Incorrect: bubble sort is O(n squared), nowhere near O(1) eviction.
Incorrect: B-trees and inverted indexes solve lookup and search, not recency ordering.
Incorrect: a Bloom filter only answers 'maybe present,' it can't track access order.

termDefinitions.term: doubly linked list / 双向链表
termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时指向前后节点的链表，可以 O(1) 从任意位置摘除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly linked list lets each node be removed from any position in O(1) time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型数据结构，能快速判断元素“可能存在”或“一定不存在”。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic structure that quickly tests whether an element might be present or is definitely absent.

q: 补全 LRU 链表语义：
text: 访问或写入一个 key 后，把对应 node 移到链表 {{head}} 附近；容量超限时，从 {{tail}} 附近删除 least recently used node。
why: 双向链表维护访问顺序，越靠头越新，越靠尾越旧。这个约定让淘汰不需要扫描。
why_en: The LRU list keeps most recently used nodes near the head and evicts from the tail.

scenario: set 一个已存在 key 时，既要更新 value/expiry，又要体现它刚被访问过。
q: 正确动作是什么？
options: 更新 value/expiry 并移到链表头部
只更新 value 字段，完全不触碰链表顺序
把整个缓存清空后重新插入这一个 key
在链表尾部再插入一个重复的 node
options_en: Update value/expiry and move it to the list head.
Only update the value field, leaving the list order untouched.
Clear the whole cache and reinsert just this one key.
Append a duplicate node at the tail of the list.
codeSample:
set(key, value, ttl):
  expiry = currentTime() + ttl if ttl else null
  if key in data:
    node = data[key]
    node.value = value
    node.expiry = expiry
    move_to_front(node)
  else:
    node = Node(key, value, expiry)
    data[key] = node
    add_node(node)
tradeoff: 更新计为一次使用 vs 只改值不动顺序
why: 更新已有 key 也是一次使用，必须把 node 移到 MRU 位置，否则它可能被错误当成 LRU 淘汰。
why_en: Updating an existing key counts as recent use, so the node must move to the MRU end or it may be wrongly evicted as least-recently-used.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务定义写入不算使用，可以不移动；标准 LRU 通常把读写都算使用。
optionExplanations: 对：更新值的同时把 node 移到链表头部。
错：只改值会让这个热 key 停留在旧位置，可能被误删。
错：这里要更新一个 key，不是清空整个缓存。
错：会产生同一个 key 的重复 node，破坏哈希表一一映射。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: update the value and move the node to the head in one step.
Incorrect: leaving the list untouched strands this hot key at its old position, risking wrong eviction.
Incorrect: the task is updating one key, not clearing the whole cache.
Incorrect: a duplicate node breaks the one-to-one hash table mapping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近使用，链表头部代表最近被访问过的位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MRU means most-recently-used, the head end of the list.

q: 哈希表 + 双向链表的 LRU 方案下，get、set、evict 的目标复杂度是什么？
options: O(log n)
O(n)
O(n log n)
options_en: O(log n)
O(n)
O(n log n)
why: 哈希表 O(1) 定位，双向链表 O(1) 摘除和插入，尾部淘汰同样 O(1)；生产实现还要补线程安全和监控。
why_en: The hash table locates in O(1), the linked list splices in O(1), and tail eviction is O(1) too — production code still needs thread-safety and monitoring on top.

q: 把 set 新 key 且容量已满的 LRU 流程排成正确顺序：
steps: 把新 node 加入 hash table 和链表头部
计算 expiry 并创建 Node
从链表尾部找到 LRU node
从 hash table 和链表中删除 LRU node
判断 size 是否超过 capacity
why: 新值先成为 MRU，再检查容量；超限时尾部就是 LRU，可以直接 O(1) 删除。
why_en: A new entry becomes most-recently-used first, then capacity is checked; on overflow the tail node is the least-recently-used and is evicted in O(1).
tradeoff: 先插入成为 MRU vs 先判断容量再插入
diagram:
flowchart TD
Set[Set new key] --> Full{Cache full}
Full -->|yes| Evict[Evict LRU tail]
Full -->|no| Insert[Insert node]
Evict --> Insert
Insert --> Head[Move to MRU head]

scenario: 缓存节点可能宕机，但本题明确高可用优先，eventual consistency 可接受，写延迟也要低。
q: 默认最贴合的复制策略是什么？
options: 同步写所有副本后才返回
主节点先确认写入，再异步复制到副本
完全不复制
每个客户端自己复制一份
options_en: Synchronously write all replicas before returning.
The primary acknowledges the write first, then replicates asynchronously.
Do not replicate at all.
Have each client keep its own copy.
tradeoff: 写延迟与可用性 vs 副本强一致
why: 异步复制不等所有副本确认，兼顾低延迟与可用性，正好匹配 eventual consistency 的要求。
why_en: Asynchronous replication doesn't wait on every replica, keeping latency low and availability high to match the eventual-consistency requirement.
whenOtherWins: 若缓存要承载强一致读写，才考虑同步复制；数据可随时重建且能容忍故障时，也可能不复制。
optionExplanations: 错：所有副本都要确认，慢副本会拖垮延迟和可用性。
对：主节点先应答，副本异步跟上，兼顾速度与可用性。
错：完全不复制，节点一故障就直接丢数据。
错：客户端各自复制没有统一视图，无法保证收敛。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: waiting on every replica lets a slow one drag down latency and availability.
Correct: the primary acknowledges first while replicas catch up asynchronously.
Incorrect: with no replication a single node failure loses data outright.
Incorrect: client-side copies have no shared view and won't converge.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接收写入并决定更新顺序的节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The primary is the node that accepts writes and determines their order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存主节点数据拷贝的节点，用于分摊读或故障切换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A replica is a node holding a copy of the primary's data, used for read scaling or failover.

q: 同步复制在本题里的主要问题是什么？
options: 写入必须等所有副本都确认，慢副本或故障会拖垮延迟和可用性
同步复制完全无法提供强一致，这跟它的设计目标相反
同步复制没法增加副本数量，副本数固定死
同步复制只能用在磁盘型数据库上，内存型缓存用不了
options_en: Every write must wait for all replicas, so a slow or failed one hurts latency and availability.
Synchronous replication cannot provide strong consistency at all, the opposite of its design goal.
Synchronous replication cannot add more replicas; the count is fixed.
Synchronous replication only works for disk-based databases, not in-memory caches.
tradeoff: 强一致保证 vs 写延迟和可用性
why: 同步复制适合强一致场景，但本题优先性能和可用性；副本越多，任一副本慢或挂都拖累写入。
why_en: Synchronous replication suits strong-consistency needs, but this cache prioritizes performance and availability, and more replicas mean more chances one is slow or down.
optionExplanations: 对：这正是同步复制在高可用场景下的代价。
错：同步复制恰恰是为了强一致，这里说反了。
错：副本数量与同步/异步无关，两者都能加副本。
错：同步复制是复制策略，不限定存储介质。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: this is exactly the cost synchronous replication pays for availability.
Incorrect: synchronous replication exists precisely to provide strong consistency — this reverses it.
Incorrect: replica count is independent of sync vs async; both can scale replicas.
Incorrect: synchronous replication is a strategy, not tied to a storage medium.

q: peer-to-peer gossip 复制相比主从异步复制的核心差异是什么？
options: 节点都能写入，靠 gossip 向外扩散更新
只有一个固定节点能接收所有写入请求
每次写入都必须强一致地提交后才算完成
多节点同时写入完全不会产生并发更新问题
options_en: Any node can accept writes and gossip the update outward.
Only one fixed node may accept all write requests.
Every write must commit with strong consistency before it completes.
Multi-node writes never create concurrent-update problems.
tradeoff: 多写入点的可用性 vs 冲突解决复杂度
why: P2P 没有单主瓶颈，可用性和扩展性更好；代价是可能有并发写同一 key，需要冲突解决。
why_en: Peer-to-peer removes the single-primary bottleneck for better availability and scale, at the cost of needing conflict resolution for concurrent writes.
optionExplanations: 对：多点写入换更高可用，但要处理并发冲突。
错：这描述的是主从复制，不是 gossip 的特点。
错：gossip 传播是异步的，不是强一致提交。
错：多点写入恰恰会产生并发更新，必须处理。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: multi-node writes buy availability but require conflict handling.
Incorrect: that describes primary-replica replication, not gossip.
Incorrect: gossip propagation is asynchronous, not a strong-consistency commit.
Incorrect: multi-node writes are exactly what creates concurrent updates to handle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点周期性随机与其他节点交换状态，逐步扩散信息的协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gossip protocol has nodes periodically exchange state with random peers so information spreads through the cluster.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当多个节点并发修改同一数据时，决定最终采用哪个值的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Conflict resolution decides which value wins when multiple nodes concurrently modify the same data.

q: 补全 Redis 复制语义：
text: Redis 默认更接近 {{asynchronous replication}}；如果客户端要等若干副本确认，可以使用 {{WAIT}} 这类半同步能力。

why_en: Redis replication is asynchronous by default, with commands like WAIT available when clients want limited replica acknowledgement.

q: 讨论缓存复制时应主动覆盖哪些问题？（多选）
options: 保留多少份副本
哪些节点存副本
副本如何同步
节点失败或网络分区时怎么办
options_en: How many replica copies to keep.
Which nodes hold the copies.
How replicas stay in sync.
What happens on node failure or network partition.
why: 高可用不能只说“加副本”，还要讲清楚副本数、放置、同步方式和故障处理这四件事。
why_en: High availability isn't just 'add replicas' — you must also cover replica count, placement, synchronization, and failure handling.
optionExplanations: 对：副本数决定成本和容错上限。
对：放置策略影响故障域隔离。
对：同步方式决定一致性和延迟。
对：故障处理决定真实可用性。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: replica count sets the cost and fault-tolerance ceiling.
Correct: placement affects failure-domain isolation.
Correct: sync strategy determines consistency and latency.
Correct: failure handling determines real-world availability.

scenario: 单机基准测得约 20k RPS，目标峰值 100k RPS。
q: 这个吞吐量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 单节点就能扛住峰值，不用加机器
至少要多台节点分担，并留 buffer
应该改用同步复制来省掉加机器
只要给这台机器加内存就够
options_en: A single node can absorb the peak; no extra machines needed.
At least several nodes must share the load, with buffer to spare.
Switch to synchronous replication instead of adding machines.
Just add more memory to the one machine.
why: 100k / 20k = 5 台起步；再留出突发流量和节点故障的 buffer，实践里常规划到约 8 台。
why_en: 100k divided by 20k RPS per node is five nodes at minimum, and buffering for traffic spikes and node failures typically pushes that toward about eight.

scenario: 每台机器 32GB 内存中约 24GB 可安全用于缓存数据，目标要存 1TB。
q: 这个存储量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 只要按吞吐规划节点数，存储可以忽略
存储需求会成为节点数的主要驱动因素，比吞吐算出的数字大得多
应该放弃缓存，直接换成持久化数据库
单机加大内存就能装下全部 1TB 数据
options_en: Sizing by throughput alone is enough; storage can be ignored.
Storage becomes the dominant driver of node count, well above what throughput alone suggests.
Abandon caching and switch to a persistent database instead.
One machine with more memory can hold the full 1TB.
why: 1024GB / 24GB 约等于 43 台，加上增长和运维余量，这个数字比吞吐驱动的估算大得多，所以存储才是决定集群大小的因素。
why_en: About 1024GB divided by 24GB usable per node is roughly 43 nodes, and with growth buffer that dwarfs the throughput-driven estimate, so storage ends up sizing the cluster.

q: 在文章的粗估里，为什么最终按约 50 个节点规划，而不是约 8 个节点？
options: 一致性协议要求固定 50 个节点
存储容量需求比吞吐需求更高
LRU 必须有 50 个节点才工作
CDN 缓存要求 50 个节点
options_en: A consistency protocol mandates exactly 50 nodes.
The storage requirement outweighs the throughput requirement.
LRU only works with exactly 50 nodes.
CDN caching requires exactly 50 nodes.
tradeoff: 存储驱动的节点数 vs 吞吐驱动的节点数
why: 吞吐只要个位数节点，但 1TB 数据要几十台机器承载；容量驱动的更大集群顺便给吞吐留出了 headroom。
why_en: Throughput alone needs single-digit nodes, but holding 1TB requires dozens of machines, and the larger storage-driven cluster happens to give throughput plenty of headroom too.
optionExplanations: 错：文章没有要求固定节点数的一致性协议。
对：两个估算取更大值，这里是存储那个。
错：LRU 是单节点内部机制，跟集群节点数无关。
错：CDN 是完全不同的缓存层，不涉及这里的节点估算。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: no consistency protocol here mandates a fixed node count.
Correct: you provision for the larger of the two estimates, and storage wins here.
Incorrect: LRU is a per-node mechanism, unrelated to cluster sizing.
Incorrect: a CDN is a different caching layer, unrelated to this node estimate.

scenario: 缓存无法放在单机上，需要把 key 分散到几十个节点，同时节点增删时尽量少搬数据。
q: 应该选择哪种路由方式？
options: hash(key) % nodeCount
consistent hashing ring
集中式数据库查路由表，每次请求先查一次
随机节点写入
options_en: hash(key) % nodeCount.
A consistent-hashing ring.
A centralized routing table looked up on every request.
Write to a random node.
tradeoff: 节点变化时的重映射代价 vs 路由实现复杂度
why: 一致性哈希把 key 和节点映射到环上，节点增删只重映射相邻区间，比取模更适合动态集群。
why_en: Consistent hashing maps keys and nodes onto a ring, so adding or removing a node only remaps a nearby range, unlike modulo hashing.
whenOtherWins: 节点数固定且很少变时，简单取模就够；需要精确容量权重时可在环上加虚拟节点。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client library] --> Ring[Hash ring]
Ring --> NodeA[Cache node A]
Ring --> NodeB[Cache node B]
Ring --> NodeC[Cache node C]
optionExplanations: 错：节点数一变，几乎所有 key 的取模结果都会变。
对：环上只有相邻区间受影响，重映射代价最小。
错：多了一次网络往返，且路由表本身是单点。
错：随机写入无法定位数据，读的时候找不到。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: changing the node count shifts almost every key's modulo result.
Correct: only the neighboring ring range is affected, minimizing remapping.
Incorrect: it adds a network hop and the routing table itself is a single point.
Incorrect: random placement means reads can't find the data again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点都映射到一个环上，节点变化只影响相邻区间的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps both keys and nodes onto a ring so a node change only affects a nearby range.

q: 简单 hash(key) % N 在节点数变化时的问题是什么？
options: 取模路由只能处理写请求，读请求全部失败
取模运算本身会报错，没法算出哈希值
大多数 key 的目标节点都会变化，需要大规模重新分布数据
取模会自动把热点 key 分散到多个节点
options_en: Modulo routing only handles writes; all reads fail.
The modulo operation itself errors out and cannot compute a hash.
Most keys' target node changes, requiring large-scale redistribution.
Modulo hashing automatically spreads hot keys across nodes.
why: N 从 4 变 5 或 3，取模结果整体改变，绝大多数 key 都要搬家；一致性哈希正是为了减少这种重映射。
why_en: When N changes from 4 to 5 or 3, the modulo result shifts for nearly every key, which is exactly what consistent hashing is designed to avoid.
optionExplanations: 错：取模用于读写路由，两者都受影响，不是只影响写。
错：哈希计算本身没问题，问题在映射到节点的方式。
对：取模对 N 高度敏感，几乎全量 key 会重新分布。
错：取模跟热点无关，也不会自动缓解热 key。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: modulo routing affects both reads and writes, not just writes.
Incorrect: hashing itself is fine; the problem is how results map to nodes.
Correct: modulo is highly sensitive to N, so nearly all keys redistribute.
Incorrect: modulo hashing has nothing to do with hot keys and won't fix them.

q: 补全一致性哈希查找规则：
text: 对 key 做哈希得到环上的位置，然后沿 {{clockwise}} 方向找到第一个 {{node}}，该节点负责存储这个 key。
why: 一致性哈希把 keyspace 变成环，节点只负责自己前一个节点之后到自己的区间。节点变化时只影响局部区间。
why_en: Consistent hashing places keys on a ring and assigns each key to the first node clockwise from its hash position.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Key[Hash key] --> Ring[Find first vnode]
Ring --> Owner[Primary node]
Owner --> Replica[Async replica]

scenario: 客户端需要本地决定 key 该发往哪个缓存节点，避免每次请求先访问中央路由服务。
q: 哪段伪代码最符合一致性哈希路由？
options: return centralRouter.lookup(key) for every request
return randomNode()
return hash(key) % oldNodeCount
pos = murmurhash(key); return firstNodeClockwise(pos)
options_en: return centralRouter.lookup(key) for every request.
return randomNode().
return hash(key) % oldNodeCount.
pos = murmurhash(key); return firstNodeClockwise(pos).
tradeoff: 客户端本地路由 vs 中央路由服务往返
why: 客户端用同一份 ring 元数据本地计算路由，省掉中央路由服务的额外网络往返。
why_en: The client computes routing locally from the same ring metadata, skipping the extra round trip to a central router.
whenOtherWins: 拓扑变化极频繁且客户端难以及时同步时，集中式路由或代理层更容易控制。
optionExplanations: 错：每次请求都往返中央服务，抵消了缓存本身的低延迟。
错：随机节点跟一致性哈希无关，读的时候找不到数据。
错：oldNodeCount 意味着还在用会大规模重映射的取模。
对：本地算出位置，直接顺时针找节点，零额外网络跳。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: a round trip to a central service on every request erases the cache's low latency.
Incorrect: a random node ignores consistent hashing, so reads can't find the data again.
Incorrect: oldNodeCount means it's still doing modulo, which remaps heavily at scale.
Correct: computing the position locally and walking clockwise adds zero extra network hops.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点都映射到一个环上，节点变化只影响相邻区间的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps both keys and nodes onto a ring so a node change only affects a nearby range.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种快速、非加密用途的哈希函数，常用于分布式系统做一致性哈希。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MurmurHash is a fast non-cryptographic hash function often used for consistent hashing in distributed systems.

q: 文章区分了哪两类 hot key 问题？（多选）
options: hot reads：某些 key 被大量读取
hot writes：某些 key 被大量并发写入
hot schemas：DDL 太频繁
hot TLS：证书过热
options_en: Hot reads: some keys receive very high read traffic.
Hot writes: some keys receive many concurrent writes.
Hot schemas: DDL changes too often.
Hot TLS: certificates overheating.
why: 读热点和写热点缓解手段不同：读靠复制分摊，写常靠批处理或拆分，混在一起容易选错方案。
why_en: Hot reads and hot writes need different fixes — replication spreads reads, while batching or sharding handles writes — so conflating them leads to the wrong fix.
optionExplanations: 对：读热点是本文讨论的两类问题之一。
对：写热点是另一类，并发更新集中在一个 key。
错：DDL 频率是数据库运维话题，不是缓存的 hot key 问题。
错：这不是一个真实存在的技术术语，纯粹跑题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: hot reads are one of the two hot-key categories discussed.
Correct: hot writes are the other — concentrated concurrent updates on one key.
Incorrect: DDL frequency is a database-ops topic, not a cache hot-key issue.
Incorrect: this isn't a real technical term — pure distraction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 传输层加密协议，用于建立安全连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TLS is a transport-layer protocol used to establish an encrypted connection.

q: 对 hot read，简单升级所有节点硬件的问题是什么？
options: 会让一致性哈希失效
只因少数热点而给全集群加钱，成本低效且没解决根因
会让 TTL 不能工作
会强制所有写变同步复制
options_en: It breaks consistent hashing.
Paying to upgrade the whole cluster for a few hot keys is costly and doesn't fix the root cause.
It disables TTL.
It forces all writes into synchronous replication.
why: 热点通常集中在少数 key 或 shard，给所有节点扩容是线性烧钱，也扛不住热点继续增长。
why_en: Hot spots usually concentrate on a few keys or shards, so upgrading every node scales cost linearly and still can't outrun a growing hotspot.
optionExplanations: 错：升级硬件和路由算法无关，一致性哈希照常工作。
对：为少数热点全局加钱，性价比差且不解决根因。
错：升级硬件不影响过期逻辑，TTL 照常生效。
错：升级硬件不改变复制策略，同步与否是独立决定。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: upgrading hardware is unrelated to the routing algorithm; consistent hashing is unaffected.
Correct: paying globally for a few hot keys is poor value and misses the root cause.
Incorrect: upgrading hardware doesn't touch expiry logic; TTL still works.
Incorrect: upgrading hardware doesn't change replication strategy, which is a separate decision.

scenario: 某个商品或 viral 内容的 key 有 100k read/s，但写入很少；单 shard 被读流量打爆。
q: 最有针对性的缓存内缓解方案是什么？
options: 直接把这个热 key 从缓存中删除，等下次访问再重建
把整个集群全部节点都改成同步复制，指望它顺便分摊读压力
给 hot key 创建多个带后缀的副本分布到不同节点，读随机选一个副本
让所有相关请求统一排队等待 1 分钟后再处理
options_en: Delete the hot key from the cache and let it be rebuilt on the next access.
Switch every node in the cluster to synchronous replication, hoping it also spreads read load.
Create several suffixed copies of the hot key spread across nodes; reads pick a copy at random.
Queue every related request for a full minute before processing.
tradeoff: 读负载分摊 vs 写入要同步更新所有副本
why: 只复制热点 key 比复制整台节点更精准，读流量能摊到多个节点；写入要更新所有副本，因此最适合读多写少。
why_en: Replicating just the hot key is more targeted than replicating a whole node, spreading reads across copies at the cost of updating every copy on a write.
whenOtherWins: 若热点是整类数据或地域问题，专用 hot-key tier 或 CDN 式层更合适；写热点不适合这种多副本方案。
diagram:
flowchart LR
HotKey[Hot read key] --> Promote[Promote replicas]
Promote --> R1[Replica A]
Promote --> R2[Replica B]
Promote --> R3[Replica C]
Client[Clients] --> R1
Client --> R2
Client --> R3
optionExplanations: 错：删除 key 会导致业务数据在重建前不可用，不是缓解手段。
错：同步复制会让所有写都变慢，跟这里的读热点无关。
对：后缀副本分散到不同节点，读随机选副本分摊压力。
错：排队 1 分钟会让用户体验直接崩溃，不是真实方案。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: deleting the key leaves it unavailable until rebuilt — not a mitigation.
Incorrect: synchronous replication slows every write and doesn't address this read hotspot.
Correct: suffixed copies spread across nodes let reads randomly pick a copy and share the load.
Incorrect: queuing for a full minute wrecks user experience — not a realistic fix.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给同一个 key 加不同后缀创建的多份拷贝，分散到不同节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A suffixed copy duplicates a key under different suffixes so copies can live on different nodes.

q: 把 hot read 副本方案的流程排成正确顺序：
steps: 读请求随机选择一个带后缀的副本 key
监控发现 product:iphone 成为 hot key
为该 key 创建 product:iphone#1/#2/#3 等副本
一致性哈希把这些副本分散到不同节点
写入该 key 时更新所有副本并接受短暂不一致
why: 先识别热点，再复制该 key 并用一致性哈希分散到不同节点；写入换来读吞吐。
why_en: The flow detects the hot key, replicates it with suffixed copies spread by hashing, and trades extra write work for read throughput.
tradeoff: 识别与复制在先 vs 写入一致性代价在后

q: “整节点 read replica”和“只复制 hot key”的关键差异是什么？
options: read replica 这种方案只能用来缓解写热点问题
两种方案在复制粒度上完全相同，没有任何区别
热点 key 的副本没法被读请求访问到
整节点复制整个 shard，热点副本只复制一个 key，更精准但要管生命周期
options_en: Read replicas can only be used to relieve hot writes.
The two approaches replicate at exactly the same granularity, no difference at all.
Copies of a hot key cannot be reached by read requests.
Full replicas copy an entire shard; hot-key copies target one key, more precise but needing lifecycle management.
tradeoff: 精准但需生命周期管理 vs 简单但开销大
why: 整节点副本能分摊读但存储和复制开销大；hot key 副本只处理真正热点，需要监控和 promote/demote。
why_en: Full-node replicas spread reads but cost more storage and replication bandwidth, while hot-key copies target only the real hotspot and need monitoring plus promote/demote.
optionExplanations: 错：read replica 主要缓解读热点，不是写热点手段。
错：两者复制粒度完全不同，不是同一回事。
错：hot key 副本就是为了被读，分摊读流量正是它的价值。
对：复制范围不同，精准度和运维成本此消彼长。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: read replicas mainly relieve hot reads, not hot writes.
Incorrect: the two differ in copy granularity — they are not the same.
Incorrect: hot-key copies exist to be read; spreading reads is their whole point.
Correct: the copy scope differs, trading precision against lifecycle overhead.

scenario: 某个 counter 每秒收到 10k 次增量写入，业务只关心短时间后最终值大致正确，不要求每次写立刻可见。
q: 哪种方案最先值得考虑？
options: 给 counter 建更多读副本
50-100ms 写批处理，把多次更新合并成一次写
把所有写改成同步复制到所有节点
禁用缓存
options_en: Add more read replicas for the counter.
A 50-100ms write batch that merges multiple updates into one write.
Switch all writes to synchronous replication to every node.
Disable the cache.
tradeoff: 写吞吐提升 vs 写可见性延迟
why: 写批处理把短窗口内的多个更新合并成一次写，显著降压；代价是写可见性延后和失败恢复的复杂度。
why_en: Write batching merges many updates in a short window into one write, cutting pressure at the cost of delayed visibility and recovery complexity.
whenOtherWins: 若每次写必须立刻可见或严格排序，批处理窗口可能不可接受；读热点更适合用复制。
optionExplanations: 错：读副本只帮读，不减少这个 counter 收到的写次数。
对：合并更新次数，直接降低单 key 的写压力。
错：同步复制只会让每次写更慢，加重而不是缓解压力。
错：禁用缓存不是缓解方案，是放弃整个系统。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: read replicas only help reads; they don't reduce writes to this counter.
Correct: merging updates directly cuts the write count hitting this key.
Incorrect: synchronous replication makes every write slower, worsening the pressure.
Incorrect: disabling the cache isn't a mitigation — it abandons the system.

scenario: 一个 hot counter 写入太多，单 key 所在节点扛不住；该操作可分解和重组，例如总数可以由多个部分相加。
q: 应该如何分散写负载？
options: 让所有请求都发到同一个节点，保持实现简单
给这个 key 加更多读副本，但所有写入仍然只打主 key
把这个 key 拆成多个 shard 子 key，写入随机选一个，读的时候聚合求和
每次写入前都对整个集群做一次全量扫描
options_en: Send every request to the same node to keep things simple.
Add more read replicas but still write only the primary key.
Split the key into multiple shard subkeys, write to a random one, and aggregate on read.
Do a full cluster scan before every write.
tradeoff: 写吞吐分散 vs 读需要聚合多个 shard
why: key sharding 用 views:video123:1..10 等子 key 分散写入，读总数时再 sum；用更慢的读换写吞吐。
why_en: Key sharding spreads writes across subkeys like views:video123:1..10 and sums them on read, trading slower reads for write throughput.
whenOtherWins: 若操作不能拆分重组，或读远多于写且延迟敏感，简单 key sharding 可能不合适。
optionExplanations: 错：单节点没有分散任何东西，热点依旧存在。
错：读副本不解决写入仍集中在同一个 key 的问题。
对：写随机分散到子 key，读时聚合还原总值。
错：每次写全量扫描是 O(n)，完全背离降压目标。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: a single node spreads nothing — the hotspot remains.
Incorrect: read replicas don't fix writes still landing on the same key.
Correct: writes fan out to subkeys and reads sum them back into a total.
Incorrect: scanning the whole cluster per write is O(n), the opposite of relief.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个热点 key 拆成多个子 key 分散写入，读时再聚合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Key sharding splits one hot key into multiple subkeys to spread writes, aggregating them again on read.

q: 补全 hot write key sharding 的取舍：
text: key sharding 把写压力从一个 key 分散到多个 {{sub-keys}}；读总值时需要 {{aggregate}} 多个 shard，因此牺牲读延迟换写吞吐。
why: 它适合可加和的 counter、metrics 等场景。子 key 太少无法分散，太多会让读聚合变慢。
why_en: Hot-write key sharding trades write scalability for more expensive aggregate reads.
tradeoff: 写吞吐提升 vs 读时聚合成本

q: 写批处理的主要风险是什么？
options: 用了批处理之后一致性哈希就没法再用
批处理之后所有读请求都会变成强一致
批处理会让写入次数变多一个数量级
批处理窗口内的更新暂时不可见，处理器失败时必须能恢复或重放
options_en: Once batching is used, consistent hashing can no longer be applied.
After batching, all reads become strongly consistent.
Batching increases the number of writes by an order of magnitude.
Updates inside the batch window are temporarily invisible, and a failed batch processor must be able to recover or replay.
why: 批处理降压的代价是延迟写可见性，还要处理缓冲期失败；适合最终一致的计数器，不适合强实时写入。
why_en: Batching's cost is delayed write visibility plus needing recovery for buffer failures, so it suits eventually-consistent counters, not real-time writes.
optionExplanations: 错：批处理是写路径优化，跟路由算法无关。
错：批处理换来的是最终一致，不是强一致。
错：批处理是合并写入，次数应该下降而不是上升。
对：可见性延后和失败恢复正是批处理的两大风险。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: batching is a write-path optimization, unrelated to the routing algorithm.
Incorrect: batching yields eventual consistency, not strong consistency.
Incorrect: batching merges writes, so the count should drop, not rise.
Correct: delayed visibility and recovery-on-failure are the two real risks of batching.

q: hot key 副本方案如果用在读写都很热的 key 上，可能会怎样？
options: 所有跟一致性相关的问题都会自动消失
写入必须更新更多份副本，反而放大了写压力和同步复杂度
读请求就没法再随机选择副本了
这个 key 的 TTL 设置会被强制禁止
options_en: All consistency-related problems disappear automatically.
Writes must update more copies, amplifying write pressure and sync complexity.
Reads can no longer randomly pick a copy.
TTL becomes forbidden for this key.
why: 读副本越多，写入要维护的一致性面越大；读多写少才是副本方案的舒适区。
why_en: More read copies mean more surface to keep consistent on every write, so replication is comfortable only when reads dominate writes.
optionExplanations: 错：多副本只解决读热点，写热点问题依然存在甚至加重。
对：每多一个副本，写入就多一次要同步的目标。
错：这个方案本身不影响读随机选择副本的能力。
错：TTL 是独立的过期机制，不受副本数量影响。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: more copies only helps hot reads; the hot-write problem remains or worsens.
Correct: every extra copy is one more target a write must keep in sync.
Incorrect: this approach doesn't affect randomized read selection.
Incorrect: TTL is an independent expiry mechanism, unaffected by replica count.

q: 文章提到哪些降低分布式缓存延迟的手段？（多选）
options: 请求批处理减少网络往返
一致性哈希避免每次查中央路由
连接池复用长连接
每次请求都新建 TCP 连接
options_en: Request batching reduces network round trips.
Consistent hashing avoids querying a central router every time.
Connection pooling reuses long-lived connections.
Opening a new TCP connection on every request.
why: 分布式后延迟不只来自内存结构，还来自网络往返和连接建立；批处理、本地路由、连接池分别削减这些开销。
why_en: Once distributed, latency also comes from network round trips and connection setup, and batching, local routing, and pooling each cut a different piece of that overhead.
optionExplanations: 对：合并请求次数，直接省网络往返。
对：客户端本地算路由，省掉查中央路由的一跳。
对：复用已建立连接，省重复握手开销。
错：每次新建连接正是要避免的尾延迟来源。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: merging requests directly saves round trips.
Correct: local client-side routing skips the hop to a central router.
Correct: reusing connections avoids repeated handshake overhead.
Incorrect: opening a fresh connection every time is exactly the tail-latency source to avoid.
optionMeanings_en: Opening a new connection each time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 面向连接的传输层协议，建立连接需要握手，有额外延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TCP is a connection-oriented transport protocol whose handshake adds setup latency.

scenario: 客户端对缓存发起高频请求，如果每次都重新建 TCP/TLS 连接，p95/p99 延迟会被握手拖高。
q: 应采用什么优化？
options: 把所有请求写到磁盘
每请求新建连接以保持干净
连接池 / 持久连接
禁用客户端 SDK
options_en: Write every request to disk.
Open a new connection per request to keep things clean.
Connection pooling / persistent connections.
Disable the client SDK.
tradeoff: 连接复用降尾延迟 vs 短连接的简单心智模型
why: 连接池复用已建立连接，避免重复握手和慢启动；缓存本身很快，连接管理常是尾延迟来源。
why_en: Connection pooling reuses established connections to skip repeated handshakes and slow-start, since connection setup is often the real source of tail latency.
whenOtherWins: 极低频的管理请求用简单短连接没问题；高频数据路径才需要复用连接。
optionExplanations: 错：写磁盘是持久化话题，跟连接管理无关。
错：每请求新建连接恰恰是尾延迟的来源。
对：复用连接省掉握手，直接压低 p95/p99。
错：禁用 SDK 无法发起请求，不是优化手段。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: writing to disk is a durability topic, unrelated to connection management.
Incorrect: opening a new connection per request is exactly the tail-latency source.
Correct: reusing connections skips handshakes and directly lowers p95/p99.
Incorrect: disabling the SDK means no requests can be made — not an optimization.

q: 为什么一致性哈希也算延迟优化？
options: 它把所有 key 都路由到了同一个节点上
它把内存里的哈希查找变成了 O(log n) 复杂度
它会在传输过程中自动压缩 value 的内容
客户端可以直接算出目标节点，省掉查询中央路由服务的一次网络往返
options_en: It routes every key to the same single node.
It turns the in-memory hash lookup into O(log n) complexity.
It automatically compresses value contents during transfer.
The client computes the target node directly, skipping a round trip to a central router.
why: 如果每次请求都先问路由服务，缓存的低延迟优势会被额外一跳吃掉；一致性哈希让路由变成本地计算。
why_en: If every request first asked a routing service, the cache's low-latency edge would be eaten by that extra hop, so consistent hashing turns routing into a local computation.
optionExplanations: 错：正相反，它的目的是把 key 分散到多个节点。
错：哈希查找本身仍是 O(1)，不是 O(log n)。
错：一致性哈希管路由，跟 value 压缩无关。
对：本地算路由，省掉那一次网络往返。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: it does the opposite — it spreads keys across many nodes.
Incorrect: hash lookup itself stays O(1), not O(log n).
Incorrect: consistent hashing governs routing, unrelated to value compression.
Correct: routing is computed locally, saving that network round trip.

scenario: 面试官没有明确要求某种淘汰策略，只说容量有限、访问模式普通，没有特别的热点规律。
q: 默认最稳妥的淘汰策略是什么？
options: FIFO（先进先出），完全按插入顺序淘汰
随机挑一个 key 直接淘汰掉
LRU（最近最少使用）
永不淘汰，内存不够时直接报错拒绝写入
options_en: FIFO (first in, first out), evicting strictly by insertion order.
Randomly pick a key to evict.
LRU (least recently used).
Never evict, and reject writes once memory runs low.
tradeoff: 贴合常见访问模式 vs 特殊热点场景的专用策略
why: LRU 假设最近用过的还会再用，适配大多数工作负载，且可用哈希表+链表做到 O(1) 淘汰。
why_en: LRU assumes recently used data will be used again, fitting most workloads while still evicting in O(1) via a hash table and linked list.
whenOtherWins: 若有一批长期稳定的热门 key，LFU 通常更合适；需要强制刷新时再叠加 TTL。
optionExplanations: 错：FIFO 忽略使用频率，可能删掉仍然很热的数据。
错：随机淘汰没有任何访问模式感知，容易删有用数据。
对：安全默认，匹配“最近用过还会再用”的大多数场景。
错：永不淘汰会让内存无限增长，最终 OOM。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: FIFO ignores usage frequency and can evict data that's still hot.
Incorrect: random eviction has no access-pattern awareness and can delete useful data.
Correct: the safe default that matches 'recently used, likely used again' for most workloads.
Incorrect: never evicting lets memory grow unbounded until the process runs out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最少使用频率淘汰策略，优先删除被访问次数最少的条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LFU evicts the entry that has been accessed the fewest times.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按插入顺序淘汰，不考虑是否仍被频繁访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO evicts by insertion order regardless of how often an entry is still being used.

q: 文章如何区分 partitioning 和 sharding？
options: 这两个词在含义上完全相反，不能互换
partitioning 泛指拆分，sharding 特指跨节点，常被混用
sharding 这个词只能用来描述单机内存里的拆分
partitioning 这个词只能用在文件系统的语境里
options_en: The two terms mean opposite things and cannot be interchanged.
Partitioning broadly means splitting data; sharding means splitting across nodes; often used interchangeably.
Sharding can only describe splitting inside a single machine's memory.
Partitioning can only apply in a file-system context.
tradeoff: 技术定义的范围 vs 分布式语境下的实际用法
why: 技术上 partitioning 可以发生在单系统内，sharding 特指跨节点；但分布式语境下两个词常被混用。
why_en: Technically partitioning can happen within one system while sharding specifically means splitting across nodes, though in distributed contexts the two words are often used interchangeably.
optionExplanations: 错：二者是包含/特化关系，不是对立关系。
对：范围包含关系，加上现实中混用的现象都说对了。
错：sharding 恰恰强调跨机器，不是单机内存概念。
错：partitioning 是通用概念，不限定文件系统场景。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: the two are a general/specific pair, not opposites.
Correct: it captures both the containment relationship and the real-world interchangeable usage.
Incorrect: sharding specifically emphasizes across-machine splitting, not single-machine memory.
Incorrect: partitioning is a general concept, not limited to file systems.

q: 把“从单机缓存到可扩展集群”的决策链排成正确顺序：
steps: 用一致性哈希把 key 分布到节点，节点变化时少搬数据
需求：1TB 数据和 100k RPS，单机无法承载
每个节点内部仍用 hash table + LRU list
容量估算显示约 50 个节点由存储驱动
对每个 shard 做异步复制以提高可用性
why: 先由容量确认必须分片，再选择一致性哈希路由，并用复制提升可用性；单节点内部的数据结构仍然是缓存行为的基础。
why_en: The scalable-cache chain starts with capacity forcing sharding, adds consistent-hash routing, layers on async replication for availability, while each node still runs a hash table plus LRU list internally.
tradeoff: 先分片保证水平扩展 vs 先复制保证可用性

q: 把“处理 hot read key”的决策链排成正确顺序：
steps: 接受写入时要更新所有副本且可能短暂不一致
需求：单个 key 的读流量压垮所在 shard
用监控识别并提升 hot key
创建多个后缀副本并分散到不同节点
读请求随机选择副本分摊负载
why: 读热点的目标是分散读，不是搬动全库；代价集中在副本管理和写入一致性上。
why_en: The hot-read chain aims to spread reads rather than move the whole dataset, concentrating its cost in replica management and write consistency.
tradeoff: 读分摊收益 vs 副本同步代价

q: 生产级 LRU 伪代码之外还必须考虑什么？
options: 删除所有过期策略
只考虑语法是否像 Python
线程安全、错误处理、监控、性能优化
禁止并发访问
options_en: Removing all expiry policies.
Only whether the syntax looks like Python.
Thread safety, error handling, monitoring, and performance tuning.
Forbidding concurrent access.
why: 文章代码只讲核心概念；真实缓存节点还要处理并发、内存压力、监控、错误和尾延迟。
why_en: The article's pseudocode only illustrates the core idea; a production cache node still needs concurrency control, monitoring, error handling, and tail-latency work.
optionExplanations: 错：生产实现要保留过期策略，不是删掉它。
错：语法是否像 Python 只是表达方式，不是工程问题。
对：这些正是伪代码故意省略、留给生产实现的部分。
错：禁止并发违背了缓存要支撑高并发的目标。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: production still keeps expiry policies rather than removing them.
Incorrect: syntax style is just presentation, not an engineering concern.
Correct: these are exactly what the pseudocode deliberately leaves for production.
Incorrect: forbidding concurrency defeats the cache's whole purpose of serving high concurrency.

q: 文章最终设计可能包含哪些要点？（多选）
options: 每个节点有 hash table 存 key-value
每个节点有 linked list 支撑 LRU
一致性哈希做分片路由
复杂 SQL 引擎处理 ad-hoc query
options_en: Each node has a hash table storing key-value pairs.
Each node has a linked list backing LRU.
Consistent hashing does shard routing.
A complex SQL engine handles ad-hoc queries.
why: 最终设计把单节点结构 hash table+LRU list 跟分布式机制分片、复制、热点处理组合起来；SQL 不是缓存主线。
why_en: The final design combines the per-node hash table and LRU list with distributed sharding, replication, and hot-key handling — SQL querying stays out of scope.
optionExplanations: 对：单节点存取的基本数据结构。
对：单节点内维护访问顺序的数据结构。
对：跨节点分片路由的机制。
错：复杂查询是数据库范畴，明确 below the line。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: the basic per-node storage structure.
Correct: the per-node structure that tracks access order.
Correct: the cross-node sharding mechanism.
Incorrect: complex querying is a database concern, explicitly out of scope.

scenario: 这是缓存而不是系统记录，源数据通常还能从后端数据库重新加载；用户可接受短暂 stale 数据。
q: 这会如何影响一致性选择？
options: 完全不允许任何副本存在，只能有一份数据
必须做到线性一致，每次读都要拿到最新写入的值
所有写入都必须走两阶段提交才能算完成
优先可用性和性能，接受 eventual consistency
options_en: No replicas are allowed at all; only one copy of the data.
Must be linearizable — every read must return the latest write.
Every write must go through two-phase commit to complete.
Prioritize availability and performance, accepting eventual consistency.
tradeoff: 可用性与延迟 vs 强一致保证
why: 缓存的价值是快和可用，短暂 stale 通常比缓存不可用更能接受；文章也明确把强一致放在范围外。
why_en: A cache's value is speed and availability, so brief staleness is usually more acceptable than the cache being unavailable, and strong consistency is explicitly out of scope.
whenOtherWins: 若缓存要承载库存扣减或余额这类唯一真相，就不能用这种弱一致假设。
optionExplanations: 错：不允许副本会直接牺牲高可用这个核心需求。
错：线性一致要求同步协调，牺牲的正是这里要保的可用性。
错：两阶段提交是跨系统事务方案，不是缓存该有的开销。
对：源数据可重建，用户能接受短暂 stale，正好换可用性。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: disallowing replicas directly sacrifices the core high-availability requirement.
Incorrect: linearizability needs synchronous coordination, sacrificing exactly the availability being prioritized here.
Incorrect: two-phase commit is a cross-system transaction tool, not overhead a cache should carry.
Correct: the source data is recoverable and users tolerate brief staleness, so it's a fair trade for availability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最强的一致性模型，所有操作看起来像是按一个全局顺序原子发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Linearizability is the strongest consistency model, making all operations appear to happen atomically in one global order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨节点事务协议，先都准备好再统一提交，保证要么全部成功要么全部回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-phase commit is a cross-node transaction protocol that first prepares all participants, then commits them together.

q: hot key 方案为什么需要监控和 promote/demote 机制？
options: 因为 LRU 机制没办法删除一个普通的 key
热点会随时间消退，副本或专用 tier 不回收就会浪费资源、增加同步成本
因为一致性哈希没办法处理新节点的加入
因为集群里所有的 key 其实永远都是热点
options_en: Because LRU cannot delete a normal key.
Hotspots shift over time, and unreclaimed copies or dedicated tiers waste resources and add sync cost.
Because consistent hashing cannot handle new nodes joining.
Because every key in the cluster is always hot.
why: 热点通常由事件驱动，可能很快消退；复制或提升后必须能降级回普通路径，否则成本和一致性负担会累积。
why_en: Hotspots are often event-driven and can fade quickly, so promoted copies must be demotable back to the normal path or cost and consistency burden keep accumulating.
diagram:
flowchart TD
Metrics[Key metrics] --> Detect[Detect hot key]
Detect --> Promote[Promote replicas]
Promote --> Observe[Watch load]
Observe --> Demote[Demote when cool]
optionExplanations: 错：LRU 淘汰和 hot key 生命周期管理是两回事。
对：热点会退潮，不回收副本就是白白多付成本。
错：一致性哈希本身能处理新节点加入，与此无关。
错：热点是少数 key 的现象，不是全部 key 的常态。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect: LRU eviction and hot-key lifecycle management are separate concerns.
Correct: hotspots fade, and unreclaimed copies simply keep costing you for nothing.
Incorrect: consistent hashing already handles new nodes joining; that's unrelated here.
Incorrect: hotspots affect a handful of keys, not the steady state of every key.

q: 把这题讲清楚时，哪些“不要过度设计”的判断是正确的？（多选）
options: API 和实体很简单，应快速通过
先做单机可工作的 TTL/LRU，再加分布式扩展
复杂查询和事务不用塞进缓存设计
必须从一开始就设计为强一致数据库
options_en: The API and entities are simple, so move through them quickly.
Build a working single-node TTL/LRU cache first, then add distributed scaling.
Complex querying and transactions don't belong in a cache design.
It must be designed as a strongly consistent database from the start.
why: 文章强调这题要展示灵活度：低层实现和高层扩展都要有，但别把范围外的数据库能力硬塞进来。
why_en: This question rewards flexibility — cover both the low-level implementation and the high-level scaling, without dragging in out-of-scope database features.

Client[Client SDK] -->|consistent hash route| N1[Cache Node A]
Client --> N2[Cache Node B]

N1 --> R1[Async Replica]

optionExplanations: 对：这两部分本来就轻，面试该把时间留给深挖。
对：先建可工作的地基，再叠加分布式复杂度是推荐顺序。
对：复杂查询和事务明确 below the line。
错：强一致数据库违背了缓存本身接受 eventual consistency 的前提。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: these two parts are inherently light, so save interview time for the deep dives.
Correct: build a working foundation first, then layer on distributed complexity — the recommended order.
Correct: complex querying and transactions are explicitly out of scope.
